summary: DOCKET 68 wave 2: read the nonlinearity limits (web instruments), vacuum entanglement as pair supply, the S5 seat route; re-screen; verify both ways

sources: Majumder et al., PRL 65, 2931 (1990): READ (abstract) via Firecrawl scrape of the publisher's public abstract page journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.65.2931. Text: '||eps||/2 pi hbar < 3.8 uHz, which corresponds to 2.0 x 10^-27 of the binding energy per nucleon'. Re-confirms M item 16.

Walsworth et al., PRL 64, 2599 (1990): READ (abstract), same route (.../PhysRevLett.64.2599). Text: '3.7x10^{20} eV (8.9 uHz)'. The exponent's minus sign is missing on the publisher's own page; -20 is derived from the printed 8.9 uHz.
Bollinger et al., PRL 63, 1031 (1989): READ (abstract), same route (.../PhysRevLett.63.1031). Text: '4 x 10^-27 on the fraction of binding energy per nucleon of the 9Be+ nucleus'.
Chupp & Hoare, PRL 64, 2261 (1990): READ (abstract), same route (.../PhysRevLett.64.2261). Text: 'less than 1.6 x 10^-26 of the binding energy per nucleon of 21Ne'.
Chupp & Hoare Erratum, PRL 66, 120 (1991): the public page was scraped but carries no abstract, so its content is NAMED-NOT-READ (H-ERRATUM).
Weinberg, PRL 62, 485 (1989): READ (abstract), same route. Used as context only: 'limits of order 10^-21 on the fraction of the energy of the 9Be nucleus'.
quant-ph/9801041v1 (Abrams & Lloyd): READ via alphaXiv, pp.1-10. Cites the four papers as refs [13]-[16] but gives no numbers.
2206.12976v1 (Broz et al.): pp.1-5 re-READ via alphaXiv. Cites the four as refs [9]-[12] and calls them 'stringent bounds', with no numbers.
2506.04298v1: READ via alphaXiv, pp.1-5 and 8. Does not cite the four.
2106.10576v2 and 2203.10269v3: passages read via Firecrawl research read_paper. Neither carries the 1989-90 numbers.
AME2020 Table I capture, through gravity.nuclides() (imported, not copied), for the binding energy per nucleon of 201Hg, 9Be and 21Ne.
results: All four Weinberg-family limits are now READ (abstract) at the publisher's public abstract pages. As frequencies: Majumder 3.8 uHz (READ); Walsworth 8.9 uHz (READ); Bollinger 6.25 uHz (5.47-7.03 across its one printed digit); Chupp-Hoare 30.8 uHz. The last two are DERIVED-FROM-READ under H-BEFRAC. Waves 1-4 recorded Majumder and Walsworth as NAMED-NOT-READ and Bollinger and Chupp-Hoare as OPEN.

The conversion from a binding-energy fraction to a frequency (H-BEFRAC) was checked on Majumder's own pair of numbers: 2.0e-27 x 7.897561 MeV / h = 3.819 uHz, against the printed 3.8 uHz (G31). The controls fail as they should (G32): using the whole-nucleus binding energy is 202x off, using the nucleon rest energy is 119x off.
Majumder's is the tightest of the four READ limits, and stays tightest across the rounding range of Bollinger's printed digit (G34).
The W2 x F1 eps window was re-run on the READ values, given W_W2R = {H-MAP, H-TRANSFER, H-SPIN, H-DILUTION}. Of 18 (cell, reading) windows, 14 are OPEN and 4 are EMPTY (G35).
EMPTY cells (both readings A and B): 1 AU with N=7 (a bound 96.5x / 193x looser would open it) and 1 AU with N=1e3 (4.43x / 8.86x looser).

OPEN cells (both readings): 1 AU with N=1e6 (a bound 7.16x / 3.58x tighter would close it), every 1 ly cell (N=7: 655x / 328x), and every 4.2465 ly cell (N=7: 2782x / 1391x; N=1e6: 1.92e6x / 9.61e5x).

Only one window depends on which READ limit applies (G36): 1 AU, N=1e3, reading A. It is EMPTY on the Majumder, Walsworth and Bollinger limits and OPEN on Chupp-Hoare's limit alone. H-SAME-EPS decides it.

These cells are no longer 'given W_W2'. 1 AU with N=7 and with N=1e3 were 'EMPTY GIVEN W_W2 -> cell OPEN (N_WREAD)'; they are now EXCLUDED given W_W2R. The other 7 cells were 'ADMISSIBLE GIVEN W_W2 (flagged)'; they are now ADMISSIBLE given W_W2R, which means not excluded, not found: each limit is an upper bound measured consistent with zero.
The tightest value (3.8 uHz) did not change, so every number from waves 1-4 is reproduced (G38). Only its status changed.
Control G37: making every limit 1e7x tighter empties all 18 windows, and making them 1e3x looser opens all 18.
No later paper or review restating the 1989-90 numbers was found (two Firecrawl search framings, alphaXiv discovery, four papers read).

Bollinger 1989 and Chupp-Hoare 1990 bounds: OPEN -> READ (abstract); their frequencies are DERIVED-FROM-READ under H-BEFRAC

W2 x F1 window at 1 AU N=1e6 and every 1 ly and 4.2465 ly cell: ADMISSIBLE GIVEN W_W2 (flagged, not settled) -> ADMISSIBLE given W_W2R (not excluded; not evidence of a drift)
W_W2 -> W_W2R = {H-MAP, H-TRANSFER, H-SPIN, H-DILUTION}: the unread bound values are removed from the window premises
open: H-MAP stays a named hypothesis: how each paper's eps (four systems, four conventions) maps onto nlcontrol's eps. The answer is in the full texts, which are behind a login wall and were not read.
H-TRANSFER, H-SPIN and H-DILUTION are unchanged named hypotheses.
H-SAME-EPS (new): whether the four experiments bound one common parameter. It decides only 1 AU, N=1e3, reading A.
H-ERRATUM (new): what Chupp & Hoare's erratum (PRL 66, 120) says is NAMED-NOT-READ.
H-BEFRAC (new): the papers' own 1989-90 binding-energy tables were not read; AME2020 values were used instead. G31 confirms the normalisation (per-nucleon binding energy), not the nuclide.
Support 2 (R_W2', the ancilla member) still has no window: UNEVALUATED.

combine.py still calls settle.window_given(), which now defaults to the wave-4 record (kept as BOUNDS_WEINBERG_WAVE4) so combine's wave-5 grounds reproduce unchanged. combine.py was not edited; moving its ground rows to settle.window_read() belongs to the seating step.
4.2465 ly is the distance as the task gave it; Proxima Centauri's distance was not read at source here. The older 4.24 ly '(illustrative)' rows in settle.py are kept unchanged as history.
selftests: python3 settle.py --selftest: 76/76 pass, 8 of them STRUCTURAL and 14 controls; counted (STRUCTURAL excluded) 68/68. Before this pass it was 67/67 with 60/60 counted. New checks G31-G38 (G32, G33 and G37 are controls) and G39 (STRUCTURAL label check).
python3 settle.py --json: rc=0. Report text is at scratchpad/d68w2/w2a-report.txt, JSON at scratchpad/d68w2/w2a-settle-out.json.

Mutation checks run outside the selftest: setting Majumder's limit to 0.2 uHz changes the G35 pattern (1 AU N=1e6 also empties). Converting with 9Be's binding energy fails G31; converting with 21Ne's would pass, which is the named limitation.

Imports still work: settle.window_given() keeps its wave-4 shape (2 unread bounds, 2 OPEN) that combine.py's tests expect, BOUNDS_WEINBERG still gives Majumder 3.8e-6, and h12_carrier_case still flips 2 cells.
problems: Walsworth's abstract on the publisher's own page prints '3.7x10^{20} eV' with no minus sign, and the rendered page drops the power entirely. This is a fault at source, recorded and not repaired; the printed 8.9 uHz fixes the exponent at -20 (G33).
G31 cannot tell 201Hg from 21Ne, because binding energy per nucleon is flat to about 1% for A between 20 and 200. It tests only the normalisation. This is stated in both settle.py and A1-settle.md.
The selftest takes about 90 s, which with --json exceeds the 120 s foreground limit; both runs were finished in the background with rc=0.
An untracked file research/warp-drive/docket68/vacuum.py appeared during the pass. It belongs to another agent and was not touched.

results: N_VAC splits in two. (i) The vacuum's entanglement reaches probes that cannot communicate, with no entangled carrier crossing: TRUE-IF {H-UDW, H-PERTURB, H-MINK-VAC, H-SPACELIKE}, READ in R1-R4, with R1's two figures reproduced. (ii) The pairs are usable by the channel with nothing crossing at <= c first: FALSE-IF {H-LOCC, H-NEARMAX, H-PROBE-OPERATED}, computed.

Control reproduced, Reznik Fig.1 and Fig.2. Fig.1 (L = T): entangled for 8.025 < Omega < 10.537 (READ: 8 < Omega < 11). Fig.2 (Omega = 9.5): entangled for L/T < 1.0974 (READ: < 1.1). The exchange amplitude computed by a momentum route and a time route agrees to 1.1e-11.

Reading note on Reznik's window. The text layer prints cos^2(t), which switches on suddenly; its emission integral diverges (it grows x1.913 as the cutoff goes from 500 to 8000). Only cos^2(pi t) reproduces both figures, so that reading is DERIVED by reproduction.

Reznik's compact window, strictly spacelike, best gap in [2, 40]: N_max/lambda^2 = 7.48e-5 at L = T and 2.97e-5 at L/T = 1.05. No gap harvests from L/T = 1.0993, so the harvest window must satisfy T > 0.9097 L/c. This computes the 0.91 that combine carries as DERIVED-FROM-READ.

Gaussian switching. PKMM's closed forms (eqs.33, 34, 37) agree with independent integrals to 1e-5. N+_max/lambda^2 is 6.31e-5 at beta = 3, 2.49e-9 at beta = 5, 4.00e-15 at beta = 7 (strong supports spacelike) and 3.07e-48 at beta = 14.

Gaussian asymptote, DERIVED here: N+_max ~ (e/2pi) e^{-beta^2/2} beta^-4 at alpha^2 ~ beta^2 - 2; computed over asymptote is 0.991 at beta = 14. N depends only on (Omega T, L/cT), so a fixed negativity at any L needs T proportional to L.

Harvested state at beta = 7, lambda = 0.1: N = 4.00e-17, and f - 1/2 = N exactly, which saturates the single-copy LOCC ceiling of R7 and R8. Teleportation fidelity is 2/3 + 2.67e-17. Copies per ebit >= 8.66e15 (R7 Prop.7, E_D <= E_N).

Every harvested case has a symmetric extension on both sides (R9 Thm 1; margin about 2 L_AA, positive with rho_ee at its floor and at 10x). So no protocol with no messages, or with messages one way, can distil it; near-maximal pairs need classical messages each way. Controls: the Werner boundary at F = 3/4 is reproduced, and a Bell state gives a negative margin.

Local operations alone (3000 random local channels plus amplitude damping): N never rises and f never passes 1/2 + N. Controls break it: a global unitary takes f to 0.9999, and a CNOT takes N on a product state from 0 to 0.5.
RRS local filtering at a gap 3x the optimum: heralded f = 0.9025 at success probability 1.8e-201. The average negativity falls, and identifying the heralded pairs takes messages from both sides.

Distillation, priced for named protocols only. Hashing threshold computed 0.81071 (READ 0.8107). BDSW's W_5/8 recurrence-hashing yield reproduced as 0.0045701 (READ 0.00457), using a 10<->11 component rotation that was identified by search, not READ.
Recurrence rounds needed before hashing pays grow as log(1/N0)/log 1.2. At beta = 7, lambda = 0.1: 201 rounds (twirl; 10^111 pairs per surviving pair) or 106 rounds (rotation; 10^61 pairs).

W2 on a harvested pair, using settle.bloch_exact (imported) under H-C2 and H-NLCONTROL-FORM. Bob's branch rho_perp = 3.10e-15, and the drift signal equals 2 eps T rho_perp^2 = 5.76e-30 at eps = 0.1, T = 3. A Bell pair gives 0.537050, reproducing settle's law. W2 x F1's pair counts assume Bell pairs.

Timeline, with the probes priced as D23 prices a pair source (settle.first_transit_times, imported). The floor for any protocol is 2.50 L/c (Gaussian beta = 7, probes from the midpoint), 3.00 L/c (probes from one end), and 2.45 / 2.95 L/c (Reznik window at L/T = 1.05).
The computed recurrence-plus-hashing protocols take 42.5-204 L/c; a midpoint pair source is ready at 0.50 L/c. Every vacuum-route floor arrives after the light time. O-BITS is untouched.

O-MAKE-DIST moves from OPEN to LEFT-IF {H-UDW, H-PERTURB, H-O4-FLOOR, H-MINK-VAC, H-SPACELIKE, H-LOCC, H-IID, H-NEARMAX, H-PROBE-OPERATED}. It stays OPEN outside that set via N_NLDIST, N_W2WEAK and N_VACNP, none computed. Distribution is relocated to the probes and to two-way messages, not removed.
grades_moved: O-MAKE-DIST: wave 1 said 'OPEN via N_VAC only'. Now LEFT-IF {H-UDW, H-PERTURB, H-O4-FLOOR, H-MINK-VAC, H-SPACELIKE, H-LOCC, H-IID, H-NEARMAX, H-PROBE-OPERATED}, and OPEN outside that set via N_NLDIST, N_W2WEAK and N_VACNP. This is vacuum.py's grade; combine.py and the ledger were not edited, because seating is a later step.

N_VAC: was a single OPEN pathway; now split. (i) TRUE-IF {H-UDW, H-PERTURB, H-MINK-VAC, H-SPACELIKE}. (ii) FALSE-IF {H-LOCC, H-NEARMAX, H-PROBE-OPERATED}. Suggested, not applied: replace N_VAC in combine's OPEN list with N_NLDIST, N_W2WEAK and N_VACNP.
combine's N_VAC window '0.91 L/c < T < L/c DERIVED-FROM-READ' is now COMPUTED: T > 0.9113 L/c at Omega = 9.5, and T > 0.9097 L/c over every gap in [2, 40].
open: N_NLDIST: a state-dependent (W2-type, non-linear) local operation that raises the pair's entanglement without messages. Not computed; under H-C2 the drift needs a branch, which means a measurement that consumes the pair.
N_W2WEAK: W2 drawing a usable signal from many weak pairs. The per-pair figure is computed (second order); the many-pair case is not.
N_VACNP: harvesting outside H-UDW or H-PERTURB (atoms and the EM field, non-perturbative couplings) that escapes the Gaussian decay in distance. No READ source was found.
No READ upper bound covers harvestable negativity over every possible window for 3+1 detectors. R2's superoscillating windows give lower bounds only, and those also fall with distance.
H-IID: whether repeated harvests at the same probes are independent is not shown.
Compact-window gaps above Omega T = 40 were not scanned.
The minimum number of two-way rounds over all distillation protocols is not known. Only the floor is established: one exchange in each direction (>= L/c) and copies >= 1/E_N.
Which rotation BDSW attribute to Macchiavello is not established. The 10<->11 map reproduces 0.00457 but was identified by search.
Whether to edit combine.py's N_VAC entry and add an N_VAC-(ii) premise under B-LOCC is left to the seating step and M.
selftests: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 vacuum.py --selftest: 50/50 counted checks pass, 10 of them controls; 9 STRUCTURAL items are printed and not counted. Exit 0, about 110 s.

Counted check B1 failed during the build. The numeric route for L_AB at alpha = beta = 7 was 3% off because the quad tolerance was too loose. The closed form was right; the numeric route was tightened and cross-checked with mpmath.
The draft's STRUCTURAL label said L_AB is purely imaginary; it is real. The label is corrected, and the history is recorded in the label and in W2B-vacuum.md.

Controls that reject plausible errors: B3 rejects the first hand-derived asymptote (off by e^2; measured ratio 7.32). A5 rejects the literal cos^2(t) window. A6 shows a factor-2 emission error would remove Fig.1's window. G4 shows the recurrence with no rotation does not reproduce 0.00457. E3/E4 break the LO bounds. F1/F2 test the symmetric-extension criterion. D3/D4 check teleportation fidelity (Bell = 1 via transit.teleport, product = 2/3).
problems: Double precision cannot resolve N ~ 1e-17 on the full 4x4 matrix: eigvalsh and SVD return 0. X-state formulas written without cancellation are used for N, f - 1/2 and the symmetric-extension margin. They are cross-checked against the generic routines on a state double precision can resolve (beta = 3, lambda = 0.3).

settle.py takes about 15 s to import and is modified in the working tree by another wave-2 item. vacuum.py imports it lazily and uses only first_transit_times, bloch_exact, bob_y_exact and constants. A later breaking edit to those would break checks H1 and I1.
The READ upper edge of Reznik's Fig.1 window ('< 11') is an approximate figure reading; the computed edge is 10.537. The selftest tolerance, [10.0, 11.5], is loose to match.

results: O-SEAT stays OPEN via S5/D25. No part of the pathway becomes shown, and no part is newly refused.

The gate's binding element at a CI-like body is P (10.70 kg/kg); the runner-up is N (8.08). Neither is measured in any star of the Proxima system in the sources read: neither is among Morel 2018's 21 alpha Cen species, and Proxima has only an [Fe/H] spread. Neither is measured in any body. So the gate cannot be evaluated at its binder on READ data. The measured alpha Cen ratios leave P as binder, moved by renormalisation only (10.70 to 10.43 kg/kg).

Element by element, the primitive conjunct: a devolatilised body (crust proxy) fails the CI budget on N 458.6, C 114.7, H 71.3 and P 17.0 kg/kg. Brugger 2016 admits both a primitive and a devolatilised Proxima b.

Proxima b's mass was READ at source: 1.07 M_earth (the board carries 1.3, second-hand). Its total mass is 8.5e21 times the CI threshold, but accessible mass is unmeasured (H-BODY-ACCESS). formation.gate returns UNDETERMINED on a synthetic aperture and NOT-EVALUABLE with none.

D23: the fabricator, survey and receiver arrive no earlier than 4.2465 yr. A survey report reaches home no earlier than 8.493 yr under H-CHECK-AT-ORIGIN. An in-situ survey is required because Proxima b does not transit.
Amortisation identity (sympy): k* = m_set K / (m_pay K - E_rec). It tends to m_set/m_pay as E_rec -> 0, and there is no k* once E_rec >= m_pay K (3.17e16 J at 0.1c for 70 kg).

Information that must arrive: 9.5e27 to 1.09e29 bits (from measure). Teleportation needs 2 classical bits plus 1 ebit per qubit and has zero advantage over light. The drift channel needs at least 8 pairs per qubit, 7.6e28 to 8.7e29 pairs in all. Its window is OPEN on the READ limits, which means not excluded, not found. In S5's one-end case a midpoint source shipped from the origin still reads no earlier than 4.2465 yr + T_drift.

Floor on the classical channel's received energy (LNM eq. 8 under H-FEW-MODES, declared T): 6.9e13 to 1.8e16 J at T = 1 yr, 100x lower at 100 yr. It prices a schedule; there is no floor independent of T. LNM eq. 6 is outside its regime here (fewer than 1 transverse mode).
branelink.py's S5 channel law A(N) = 3 hbar N^2 ln^2 2 / pi, read from its source, equals LNM eq. 8 at one polarisation (sympy). At two polarisations it differs by exactly 2.

DOCKET 56's owed instrument is now specified: N(spec) is computed (imported from measure); E_tx has a floor computed for a declared schedule; E_fab is computed nowhere; E_hold has a negligible floor; m_set is specified nowhere; k* is given as an identity.
open: P and N abundance of any body in the Proxima arrival aperture (the gate's binder is unmeasured)
Proxima b's primitive status (water mass fraction 0-50% admitted)
Accessible mass, and the arrival aperture (formation: NOT EVALUABLE)
E_fab, the energy to separate the feedstock and assemble 6.7e27 atoms: computed nowhere on the board
m_set, the mass of fabricator, survey and receiver: specified nowhere
Transmitted (not just received) channel energy at real apertures, including diffraction loss
Which count is the specification (H-ALT)
H-CONATAL: whether Proxima formed with alpha Cen is not settled (Morel 2018)
